column1: # The pure tests that walk the repository, and the path prefixes each walks (scan_select.py; README, "The scans a slice's
# checks include"). The line's file: neither the conductor nor any slice can change it (the guard; the merge script's
# protected paths). Columns: the test (relative to OspreyFlow_Build), its prefixes from the repository root (comma
# separated; a folder ends in /), or - when it walks only its own temporary folder or reads named files, then why.
# A slice's checks run every row whose prefixes a path its branch changes falls under. A pure test that walks a folder
# and has no row fails the line's suite (test_the_real_scan_map_names_every_pure_walker_and_nothing_stale). First
# review: 18 November 2026, by reading each test (the live tests, make test's --ignore list, are left out).
